concurrencyVerification.isolation: Each process() call replaces EXEC with a fresh ListExecutor, isolating imports, actor objects, library registrations and instances, symbols, and fixture-owned state.
concurrencyVerification.model: fork one worker per accepted SLiM connection; listener parent accepts and reaps children

concurrencyVerification.socketCleanup: Parent closes its accepted-socket copy; process() closes the worker socket on BYE, EOF, or exception; malformed input is contained in the worker; SIGCHLD handler reaps exited workers.

hashResultIncrement.behavior: Test::FitNesse::Slim::MapResult converts only plain hash-reference method results before SLiM list serialization. It emits stable sorted rows, escapes ordinary text, preserves valid HTML, maps undefined cells to null, recursively converts nested maps/lists, and requires explicit string conversion for object values so opaque references cannot leak as Perl addresses. It does not alter array/list results or symbol/object identity.

coverage: exact MapConverter table output and key ordering
Unicode map output survives SLiM list serialization
regression.preFix: Failed 7 assertions; the returned result was HASH(0x6401465af600).

hashResultIncrement.rootCause: StatementExecutor::call returned a plain Perl hash reference unchanged. Test::FitNesse::Slim::List only recursively serializes arrays; for a hashref it retained a raw reference value and serialized it as HASH(0x...), rather than FitNesse map HTML.
hashResultIncrement.upstreamReference: Installed FitNesse v20251025 HashFixture.hash() returns a sorted TreeMap copy. MethodExecutionResult converts Map values with MapConverter before SlimSerializer; MapConverter emits hash_table/hash_row/hash_key/hash_value HTML and applies FitNesse HTML escaping to ordinary values.

historicalCrash.cause: A valid nested SLiM statement had an empty-string argument. _take_utf16_units consumed the following colon for a requested length of zero; nested list parsing failed and returned the encoded statement as a scalar. ListExecutor then dereferenced it as an arrayref. The fix avoids consuming any characters for zero units.

scenarioActorInvestigation.diagnosticArrayText: Statement.pm debug warn interpolates nested arrayref arguments as ARRAY(0x...). This is diagnostic output only; the parsed nested list is serialized recursively for the socket frame.
scenarioActorInvestigation.expectedSemantics: If the named actor has no matching instance/method, registered libraries are searched newest-first. cloneSymbol returns its argument object unchanged, preserving symbol identity.
perlChanges: Missing scenario actor names now fall through to registered-library lookup before NO_INSTANCE.
The null-target cloneSymbol helper substitutes and returns its exact argument object.
scenarioActorInvestigation.rootCause: Executor defect, not a fixture or incorrect scenario binding. FitNesse library method lookup is newest-first after actor/SUT lookup; SlimHelperLibrary provides cloneSymbol and the actor stack helpers, and scenario steps use synthetic scriptTableActor calls.

sleepFixtureIncrement.behavior: Stores timer values in milliseconds, sleeps for the constructor or timer value, returns WakeUp plus the duration, and raises IllegalArgumentException for a negative duration.

regression.preFix: Fixture loading failed with NO_CLASS Sleep; subsequent calls reported NO_INSTANCE.

sleepFixtureIncrement.timeoutCaveat: The pages ran against the already connected external server. Their returned table values verify fixture behavior, not FitNesse runner startup flags.

slimHelperLibraryIncrement.behavior: Each StatementExecutor constructs a private helper library and registers it as the oldest library, so explicit libraries remain newer and actor methods keep precedence. get_fixture returns the current scriptTableActor reference or reports NO_INSTANCE when missing. push_fixture pushes that reference; pop_fixture restores the exact object reference and raises EmptyStackException on an empty stack. The stack is owned by one executor/session. TestSlim uses its upstream string representation only for stringification, while overloaded equality and is_same retain reference-identity semantics.
slimHelperLibraryIncrement.remainingAffectedFailure: DefineAliasTest remains fixture-blocked by AddUpChange; exceptions fell from 73 to 67, including the expected missing-actor errors after failed fixture creation.
slimHelperLibraryIncrement.serverStability: All 50 responses identified the external SlimService connection at 127.0.0.1:8099 and reported exit code 0; the Perl listener remained alive after the inventory.
slimHelperLibraryIncrement.upstreamReference: Installed FitNesse v20251025 fitnesse.slim.SlimHelperLibrary. The upstream helper calls StatementExecutor.getInstance("scriptTableActor"), pushes that object, and restores it on pop; the executor reports NO_INSTANCE when the actor does not exist. Source mirror: https://www.javatips.net/api/fitnesse-master/src/fitnesse/slim/SlimHelperLibrary.java.

stopExceptionIncrement.behavior: ConstructorThrows reproduces normal, stop-test, and stop-suite constructor exceptions. DecisionTableExecuteThrows reproduces the upstream SlimError methods and table hooks. StatementExecutor formats Java-style exception payloads and emits ABORT_SLIM_TEST or ABORT_SLIM_SUITE for stop exceptions. ListExecutor halts the remaining instructions in the current batch and clears stop state before the next batch. FitNesse remains responsible for page/suite continuation and teardown.

stopPageOrderInvestigation.harnessIsolation: Before each page request, POST confirmed=yes to /MySuite?deletePage. Use the deletePage responder in the URL; a POST without the responder query is not the correct cleanup request.
stopPageOrderInvestigation.previousCommitComparison: A temporary source snapshot of dc7561e reproduced the same failure only when the generated SuiteSetUp persisted. No stop implementation changed between that snapshot and the current commit; the older full inventory passed because it ran the stop pages before the setup page.
stopPageOrderInvestigation.repeatedRunEvidence: The opt-in t/stop-page-order.t run first reproduced the contaminated results, then repeated StopTest twice and StopSuite twice after resetting MySuite; all isolated StopTest and StopSuite runs were 6/0. It also ran StopSuite then StopTest in reverse order; both were 6/0.
stopPageOrderInvestigation.rootCause: FitNesse stores PageDriver-created pages between individual HTTP test requests. StopTestInSuiteSetUp creates MySuite.SuiteSetUp and does not remove it. If it runs first, that stale setup throws StopTest for later MySuite-based pages, causing per-test TearDown rows to be ignored. The earlier full inventory ran StopSuite and StopTest before StopTestInSuiteSetUp, so its 6/0 counts were order-dependent, not false XML parsing or an SLiM engine pass.
stopPageOrderInvestigation.upstreamBehavior: FitNesse SlimTestSystem consumes ABORT_SLIM_TEST and ABORT_SLIM_SUITE, applies stop state to subsequent tables, and runs applicable TearDown and SuiteTearDown tables. With no stale SuiteSetUp, the existing Perl exception markers produce the expected page behavior.
